Joining our team

As of Oct 2026, all project positions are currently filled.

We will post future openings here around spring 2027, on:

  • post-doc in visulization, HCI, and collaboration
  • visualization engineer and software developer
  • research interships

Note that all positions are in-person either in Bordeaux or Paris and that we do generally not accept remote positions.

Possible candidates need to fluent in English. Fluency in French is highly suggested, though not strictly required. The project involves international as well as local French partners and collaboration with the (French) general public.

In the meantime, we welcome requests of exceptional candidates.
